datasets.name: ODS_Rep
datasets.sql:
select transmode_code, report_code,custid,b.name,sum(lammount) lammount,dk  from (
select ti.transmode_code,ti.report_code,l.kcustid as custid,sum(l.lamount) lammount, 1 as dk  from mmx_transactions l,mmx_transinfo ti 
where l.id=ti.transid and (l.debitbalance in (select bal_cn from bal_spr1 where goaml=1) and l.debitbalance in ('1001','1011','1003'/*turanBank*/,'2509','2801','2811'))
and l.transactiondate=:V_DAT and ti.report_code='CTR'
group by ti.transmode_code,ti.report_code,l.kcustid 
union all
select ti.transmode_code,ti.report_code,l.dcustid as custid  , sum(l.lamount) lammount,2 as dk from mmx_transactions l,mmx_transinfo ti 
where l.id=ti.transid and (l.creditbalance in (select bal_cn from bal_spr1 where goaml=1) and l.creditbalance in ('1001','1011','1003'/*,'2509','2801','2811'*/))
and l.transactiondate=:V_DAT and ti.report_code='CTR'
group by ti.transmode_code,ti.report_code,l.dcustid) a, customers b where a.lammount>=20000 and a.custid=b.id

group by transmode_code, report_code,custid ,name,dk 
order by transmode_code

datasets.name: ods_sub1
datasets.sql:
select aa.id custid ,aa.name cust_name,aa.ammount,'1' type,('10000 USD Limit ay erzinde') as description from (
 select c.id,c.name,sum(p.lammount)as ammount from customers c,account a, provarch p where
 c.id=a.kli_id 
 and a.id=p.debt 
 and exists (select id from account where id=p.debt and bal_cn1 like'38%')
 and exists (select id from account where id=p.kredit and bal_cn1 in('2801','2811','2509','2519','4509','4519'))
 and nvl(p.vid_op,0) not in(1,3)
 and c.cust_type=1 
 and p.dat between :v_dat1 and :v_dat2
 and p.val_acc<>0
 group by c.id,c.name 
 order by c.id) aa 
 where aa.ammount>=17000

 c.id=a.kli_id and
 a.id=p.kredit 
 and 
   exists (select a.id from account  a ,customers c,black_countries b,custinfo i where p.kredit=a.id and a.kli_id =c.id and i.idcust=c.id and b.contid=i.citizenship  and a.bal_cn1 like'38%') 
    
  and nvl(p.vid_op,0) not in(1,3) and p.dat =:v_dat2

 select   c.id custid,c.name cust_name,sum(p.lammount)as ammount from customers c,account a, provarch p where

datasets.name: ods_sub4

select custid,cust_name, ammount,'4' type,('Fiziki sexe 10000 daxil olma') as description from (
 select c.id custid,c.name cust_name,sum(p.lammount)as ammount from customers c,customers c1,account a,account b, provarch p where

 and (select kli_id from account where id=p.debt)<>(select kli_id from account where id=p.kredit)
 and p.dat =:v_dat2
